name: Quail
description: Small game bird, roasted or curried whole — two to a person.

tcm.note: An chun tonifies qi and strengthens the tendons and bones.

ayurveda.note: Ushna; game birds are the heating end of the meat group.

unani.note: Bater is famously garam in desi Unani usage, given in winter and for weakness.
